output.one_liner: Zendesk is a cloud-based customer support platform for managing tickets, help center articles, voice calls, and customer conversations across multiple channels.

auth.notes: OAuth2 is recommended and primary; basic auth used for deprecated API tokens scheduled for removal April 30, 2027. OAuth tokens sent as Bearer in Authorization header.

evidence.snippet: Zendesk supports using OAuth access tokens to authenticate API requests.
If you plan on distributing an app, integration, or bot to multiple Zendesk customers, you must use global OAuth tokens
Basic authentication is used for API tokens.

access.notes: Free 14-day trial without credit card; continued use requires paid Zendesk account. OAuth client setup requires Zendesk admin access.

evidence.snippet: You can try out the Zendesk platform with a free, 14-day trial account.
If you're interested in becoming a Zendesk developer partner, you can convert your trial account into a sponsored Zendesk Support account.
Sign in to Zendesk Admin Center at https://<subdomain>.zendesk.com/admin/home.

api_surface.rate_limit_note: Plan-dependent: 200-2500 requests/minute for Support API depending on plan type. Returns 429 Too Many Requests when exceeded.

evidence.snippet: Zendesk's APIs are organized around REST principles.
Most of our APIs are organized by product capabilities.
You'll find APIs for ticketing, help center, live chat, voice, sales CRM
Webhooks let you build or set up integrations that subscribe to certain activity in Zendesk Support, Guide, Gather, and Messaging.
If the rate limit is exceeded, the API responds with a 429 Too Many Requests
A Model Context Protocol (MCP) server that puts Zendesk inside your AI assistant

buildability.rationale: Free trial with documented OAuth and REST API enable development, but production use requires paid Zendesk account.
